items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: 3 Financials Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Financial providers use their expertise in capital allocation and risk assessment to help facilitate economic growth while offering consumers and businesses essential financial services. Furthermore, supportive sentiment has created ideal market conditions, a trend that has enabled the industry to return 15.4% over the past six months. At the same time, the S&P 500 was up 13.1%.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: S&P 500 Hovers Near Record Highs on US-Iran Hopes
items.summary: Stocks traded near all-time highs and bonds rose as hopes for a deal to revive the Strait of Hormuz trimmed a rally in oil prices. Eric Freedman, CIO at Northern Trust, discusses the current market landscape.
